summary: Implemented Console.out in rich/console.py (placed after print; delegates to print with emoji=False, markup=False, no_wrap=True, overflow="ignore", crop=False; highlight defaults to True). Added tests in tests/test_console.py (test_out plus markup/emoji, pretty-print, no-crop, style, highlight default/None/False, and render-hook tests), a CHANGELOG entry under Unreleased/Added, and a "Low level output" section in docs/source/console.rst after logging. Nothing was run or committed, per instructions; expected strings in the style and highlight tests were traced by hand and should be checked when tests are run.
